name: Model Context Protocol tools (spec revision 2026-07-28, 'latest'; 2025-06-18 also checked)

example.name: get_weather
example.title: Weather Information Provider
example.description: Get current weather information for a location

fields.name: required; unique identifier (see name_rule)
fields.title: optional; human-readable display name
fields.inputSchema: required; JSON Schema object, MUST NOT be null; defaults to JSON Schema 2020-12 when no $schema; no-param tools: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false} (recommended) or {"type":"object"}; properties MAY carry x-mcp-header
fields.outputSchema: optional JSON Schema for structuredContent; if given, server MUST conform, client SHOULD validate
fields.annotations: optional behavior hints; clients MUST treat as untrusted unless server is trusted

tool_result.error: Two mechanisms: (1) protocol errors = JSON-RPC error object (unknown tool, malformed request, server error), e.g. code -32602; (2) tool execution errors = normal result with isError: true and message in content (API failures, input validation errors such as bad date format, business logic errors). Clients SHOULD pass execution errors to the model.

name_rule: SHOULD be 1-128 chars, case-sensitive, only A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - . (i.e. ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}$), no spaces/commas, unique within a server (2026-07-28 spec)
schema_rules: content items: text, image (base64 data + mimeType), audio, resource_link, embedded resource; all accept optional annotations.
structuredContent may be any JSON value (2026-07-28; 2025-06-18 said JSON object) and SHOULD also be serialized into a TextContent block for backwards compatibility.
2026-07-28 adds resultType ('complete' | 'input_required'), InputRequiredResult for multi round-trip, and requires _meta on every request (protocolVersion/clientInfo/clientCapabilities).
x-mcp-header only on primitive integer/string/boolean properties statically reachable from root; clients on Streamable HTTP MUST drop tools violating x-mcp-header constraints.

sources.what: 2026-07-28 Tool fields, name rules, inputSchema rules, result shape, resultType, error handling
earlier revision: Tool fields, structuredContent as object, isError, protocol vs execution errors (no name rule there)

uncertain: Annotation keys (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint, title) are from memory of schema.ts; the tools page only says 'optional properties describing tool behavior'.
Intermediate revision 2025-11-25 was not fetched; which revision introduced the name rule is unconfirmed.
